sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A precision fight in 3 phases (100-75%, 75-40%, 40-0%) plus two intermissions, built around not letting "Sparks" reach her. Tight 10-minute enrage — low-DPS squads feel it hard in the final 10%.

sections.heading: Fluxlance & conduits
bullets: Orange Arrow targets the furthest player(s) — after a 5s cast it fires a beam that applies Galvanic Sensitivity (massively boosts Spark damage to whoever's hit) and charges any conduit in its path. Phase 1 is a single arrow; phases 2-3 target the 5 furthest players (sequential in phase 2, simultaneous in phase 3).
Red Arrow (all phases) instantly kills anyone in its path — stand behind an uncharged conduit to block it.
Conduits charge up to 3 times and release Sparks during Seismic Crash — a Spark reaching Decima gives her a Charge stack, and 10 stacks is a squad wipe.

sections.heading: Sparks
bullets: Sparks freeze once enough players are standing in them (more players = faster dissipation). In phase 1, anyone not kiting can soak a spark; in phases 2-3, only the boss group should soak — Galvanic Sensitivity makes it lethal for anyone else.

sections.heading: Seismic Crash, Wind, and Green Arrow
bullets: Seismic Crash: an instant-kill jump-crash near her, followed by a knockback and then a Spark release — Stability or CC-immunity gets you through it safely.
Wind (phases 2-3): forcibly rotates players around her (direction is random each cast) — fully countered by Stability. Phase 2 only affects the outer ring; phase 3 hits the whole platform.
Green Arrow (phase 3 only): 5 players must stand in it at detonation or the whole squad gets Exposed — missing players makes the targeted conduit overcharge instead.

sections.heading: Intermissions (75% / 40%)
bullets: Decima channels with a defiance bar while everyone loses Galvanic Sensitivity, so the whole squad can soak Sparks freely — break the bar for a 10-second stun, but any Spark that reaches her during this fully regenerates it.

Each intermission ends with Fulminate/Flux Nova, detonating every conduit — any conduit at max charge when this goes off gives the squad an Exposed stack and Decima 5 stacks of Harmony and Discord each, so clear conduits down before the detonation.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 10:00 hard enrage — tighter than most other raid bosses, so don't expect to coast through phase 3.
